name: Archivist of Oghma
oracle_text:
Flash
Whenever an opponent searches their library, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Whenever an opponent searches their library, you gain 1 life and draw a card.

needs.what: a trigger event fired each time a player searches their library (701.23), carrying the searching player so a trigger can filter on `controller: opponent`; it must fire once per search instruction (search_library / search_zones including a library, fetchland and tutor costs alike), including searches that find nothing or are stopped by cant_search_library-style effects only if the search still occurs
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no search event: `ability_activated` and `spell_cast` fire on the cause rather than the search and would miss or over-count (a spell that searches conditionally, a land's fetch ability, a resolved tutor); `shuffle` is not an event either, and a shuffle is not a search. The static `cant_search_library` shows the engine knows when a search happens, but nothing exposes it to triggers
